headline: Singapore's Keppel Posts 20% Increase in Third-Quarter Net Profit
summary: Singapore global asset manager Keppel reported a 20% year-on-year increase in net profit for the third quarter, driving a minor uptick in its share price.
why: Keppel is a leading Singaporean asset manager operating globally across energy, infrastructure, real estate, and data center investments.

impacts.name: Keppel Ltd.
impacts.why: Solid net profit gains support investor sentiment following the firm's strategic pivot to asset management.
